correctness.rationale: The lead full text gives the \(D_d\) quadratic coefficients in equation (9.1), the scalar \(E_6,E_7,E_8\) coefficient in equation (9.2), and the \(A_2\) scalar coefficient in the proof of Theorem 9.1. Orthogonality of diagonal and off-diagonal symmetric matrices makes those coefficients the two Hessian stiffnesses. Exact factorization gives \(\kappa_d-1=(d-1)(d-4)/(d(2d-3))\); exact subtraction gives \(\kappa_{d+1}-\kappa_d=(7d^2-9d+4)/(d(d+1)(2d-3)(2d-1))\). Both signs and the limit \(3/2\) follow for every integer \(d\ge4\).

value.rationale: The finding gives a complete spectral-geometry summary of all irreducible root-lattice local minima: it separates the isotropic cases from the entire anisotropic \(D_d\) tail and quantifies that tail by an exact monotone condition number with sharp limiting value \(3/2\). This is a natural invariant of the source's stability Hessian and directly identifies the special role of \(D_4\) within the \(D\)-family.
